summary: Bound the ordered FMA prefix error by a sum of local half-ULP rounding budgets.
Add the bias rounding budget and preserve the bound through ReLU and the concrete kernel output store.
Require finite inputs and executed intermediate results while allowing signed zeros and subnormals.

from.quote:
The numerical bound compares the kernel's ordered binary32 computation with
exact real arithmetic on the values represented by the same input words.
It introduces no input-encoding error. The input width and output row count
remain parameters.

/-- Exact sum of the first k represented products, with no input-conversion error. -/
noncomputable def exactPrefix (data : TensorData layout rows) (i : Fin rows) (k : Nat) : ℝ :=
  (((rowTerms data i).take k).map (fun pair => FP32.toReal pair.1 * FP32.toReal pair.2)).sum

/-- Exact real argument rounded at this FMA site, using the actual incoming accumulator. -/
noncomputable def fmaSite (data : TensorData layout rows) (i : Fin rows)
    (j : Fin layout.inputWidth) : ℝ :=
  FP32.toReal (data.weights i j) * FP32.toReal (data.input j) +
    FP32.toReal (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i j.val)

/-- The first k local half-ULP budgets, including the subnormal grid. -/
noncomputable def prefixErrorBudget (data : TensorData layout rows) (i : Fin rows) (k : Nat) : ℝ :=
  ((List.ofFn (fun j => Model.epsilonAt FloatFormat.binary32 (fmaSite data i j))).take k).sum

def preactivation (data : TensorData layout rows) (i : Fin rows) : FP32.Bits :=
  FP32.floatLibArithmetic.addRN
    (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i layout.inputWidth) (data.bias i)

noncomputable def traceErrorBudget (data : TensorData layout rows) (i : Fin rows) : ℝ :=
  prefixErrorBudget data i layout.inputWidth +
    Model.epsilonAt FloatFormat.binary32
      (FP32.toReal (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i layout.inputWidth) +
        FP32.toReal (data.bias i))

noncomputable def exactRowResult (data : TensorData layout rows) (i : Fin rows) : ℝ :=
  max ((∑ j : Fin layout.inputWidth,
    FP32.toReal (data.weights i j) * FP32.toReal (data.input j)) + FP32.toReal (data.bias i)) 0

/-- Finite inputs alone do not prevent overflow: every executed rounded result is required finite. -/
structure FiniteRowTrace (data : TensorData layout rows) (i : Fin rows) : Prop where
  weights : ∀ j, FP32.isFinite (data.weights i j) = true
  input : ∀ j, FP32.isFinite (data.input j) = true
  bias : FP32.isFinite (data.bias i) = true
  accumulators : ∀ k : Fin (layout.inputWidth + 1),
    FP32.isFinite (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i k.val) = true
  preactivation : FP32.isFinite (preactivation data i) = true

from.quote:
Each FMA contributes at most half an ULP at its exact product-plus-addend,
using the actual rounded accumulator entering that step. The bias addition
contributes the same kind of local bound. The budget is the sum of these local
half-ULP bounds, including the gradual-underflow grid near zero.

private theorem exactPrefix_succ (data : TensorData layout rows) (i : Fin rows)
    (k : Nat) (hk : k < layout.inputWidth) :
    exactPrefix data i (k + 1) = exactPrefix data i k +
      FP32.toReal (data.weights i ⟨k, hk⟩) * FP32.toReal (data.input ⟨k, hk⟩) := by
  have hlen : k < (rowTerms data i).length := by simpa [rowTerms] using hk
  unfold exactPrefix
  rw [← List.take_concat_get hlen, List.concat_eq_append, List.map_append, List.sum_append]
  simp [rowTerms]

private theorem prefixErrorBudget_succ (data : TensorData layout rows) (i : Fin rows)
    (k : Nat) (hk : k < layout.inputWidth) :
    prefixErrorBudget data i (k + 1) = prefixErrorBudget data i k +
      Model.epsilonAt FloatFormat.binary32 (fmaSite data i ⟨k, hk⟩) := by
  have hlen : k < (List.ofFn (fun j => Model.epsilonAt FloatFormat.binary32 (fmaSite data i j))).length := by
    simpa using hk
  unfold prefixErrorBudget
  rw [← List.take_concat_get hlen, List.concat_eq_append, List.sum_append]
  simp

private theorem fma_abs_error_le (w x a : FP32.Bits)
    (hw : FP32.isFinite w = true) (hx : FP32.isFinite x = true) (ha : FP32.isFinite a = true)
    (hout : FP32.isFinite (FP32.floatLibArithmetic.fmaRN w x a) = true) :
    |FP32.toReal (FP32.floatLibArithmetic.fmaRN w x a) -
        (FP32.toReal w * FP32.toReal x + FP32.toReal a)| ≤
      Model.epsilonAt FloatFormat.binary32 (FP32.toReal w * FP32.toReal x + FP32.toReal a) :=
  Model.abs_toReal_fma_sub_le (FP32.decode w) (FP32.decode x) (FP32.decode a)
    (by decide) hw hx ha hout

/-- The ordered rounded prefix differs from the exact prefix by at most its accumulated budget. -/
theorem prefixAccumulator_abs_error_le (data : TensorData layout rows) (i : Fin rows)
    (hfinite : FiniteRowTrace data i) (k : Nat) (hk : k ≤ layout.inputWidth) :
    |FP32.toReal (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i k) - exactPrefix data i k| ≤
      prefixErrorBudget data i k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [exactPrefix, prefixErrorBudget]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hlt : k < layout.inputWidth := by omega
    have hprev := ih (by omega)
    have hlocal := fma_abs_error_le
      (data.weights i ⟨k, hlt⟩) (data.input ⟨k, hlt⟩)
      (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i k)
      (hfinite.weights _) (hfinite.input _) (hfinite.accumulators ⟨k, by omega⟩)
      (by rw [← prefixAccumulator_succ _ _ _ _ hlt]; exact hfinite.accumulators ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩)
    rw [prefixAccumulator_succ _ _ _ _ hlt, exactPrefix_succ _ _ _ hlt,
      prefixErrorBudget_succ _ _ _ hlt]
    unfold fmaSite
    have htriangle := abs_add_le
      (FP32.toReal (FP32.floatLibArithmetic.fmaRN (data.weights i ⟨k, hlt⟩)
        (data.input ⟨k, hlt⟩) (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i k)) -
          (FP32.toReal (data.weights i ⟨k, hlt⟩) * FP32.toReal (data.input ⟨k, hlt⟩) +
            FP32.toReal (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i k)))
      (FP32.toReal (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i k) - exactPrefix data i k)
    have heq : FP32.toReal (FP32.floatLibArithmetic.fmaRN (data.weights i ⟨k, hlt⟩)
        (data.input ⟨k, hlt⟩) (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i k)) -
        (exactPrefix data i k + FP32.toReal (data.weights i ⟨k, hlt⟩) * FP32.toReal (data.input ⟨k, hlt⟩)) =
      (FP32.toReal (FP32.floatLibArithmetic.fmaRN (data.weights i ⟨k, hlt⟩)
        (data.input ⟨k, hlt⟩) (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i k)) -
          (FP32.toReal (data.weights i ⟨k, hlt⟩) * FP32.toReal (data.input ⟨k, hlt⟩) +
            FP32.toReal (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i k))) +
      (FP32.toReal (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i k) - exactPrefix data i k) := by ring
    rw [heq]
    exact htriangle.trans (by linarith)

After bias addition and ReLU, the decoded row result differs from the exact
dense-ReLU formula by at most that FMA budget plus the bias-addition bound.
The ReLU step adds no error term. The same budget therefore bounds the decoded
word stored by the existing concrete kernel execution theorem.

/-- Bias addition contributes one further half-ULP bound. -/
theorem preactivation_abs_error_le (data : TensorData layout rows) (i : Fin rows)
    (hfinite : FiniteRowTrace data i) :
    |FP32.toReal (preactivation data i) -
        (exactPrefix data i layout.inputWidth + FP32.toReal (data.bias i))| ≤
      traceErrorBudget data i := by
  have hdot := prefixAccumulator_abs_error_le data i hfinite layout.inputWidth (by omega)
  have hbias := Model.abs_toReal_add_sub_le
    (FP32.decode (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i layout.inputWidth))
    (FP32.decode (data.bias i)) (by decide)
    (hfinite.accumulators ⟨layout.inputWidth, by omega⟩) hfinite.bias hfinite.preactivation
  change |FP32.toReal (preactivation data i) -
    (FP32.toReal (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i layout.inputWidth) +
      FP32.toReal (data.bias i))| ≤
    Model.epsilonAt FloatFormat.binary32
      (FP32.toReal (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i layout.inputWidth) +
        FP32.toReal (data.bias i)) at hbias
  have heq : FP32.toReal (preactivation data i) -
      (exactPrefix data i layout.inputWidth + FP32.toReal (data.bias i)) =
    (FP32.toReal (preactivation data i) -
      (FP32.toReal (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i layout.inputWidth) +
        FP32.toReal (data.bias i))) +
    (FP32.toReal (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i layout.inputWidth) -
      exactPrefix data i layout.inputWidth) := by ring
  rw [heq]
  exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by unfold traceErrorBudget; linarith)

private theorem exactPrefix_full (data : TensorData layout rows) (i : Fin rows) :
    exactPrefix data i layout.inputWidth =
      ∑ j : Fin layout.inputWidth, FP32.toReal (data.weights i j) * FP32.toReal (data.input j) := by
  unfold exactPrefix rowTerms
  rw [List.take_of_length_le (by simp), List.map_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn]
  rfl

/-- ReLU adds no error budget to the FMA loop and bias addition. -/
theorem rowResult_abs_error_le (data : TensorData layout rows) (i : Fin rows)
    (hfinite : FiniteRowTrace data i) :
    FP32.isFinite (rowResult FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i) = true ∧
    |FP32.toReal (rowResult FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i) - exactRowResult data i| ≤
      traceErrorBudget data i := by
  constructor
  · exact FP32.isFinite_maxPositiveZero (preactivation data i) hfinite.preactivation
  · change |FP32.toReal (FP32.maxPositiveZero (preactivation data i)) - _| ≤ _
    unfold exactRowResult
    rw [← exactPrefix_full]
    exact (FP32.maxPositiveZero_abs_error_le _ hfinite.preactivation _).trans
      (preactivation_abs_error_le data i hfinite)

/-- Concrete kernel execution stores the numerically bounded result and preserves the memory frame. -/
theorem kernel_abs_error_le (cfg : Launch) (layout : Layout) (hfit : cfg.rows ≤ 2 ^ 32)
    (data : TensorData layout cfg.rows) (env : Environment) (args : Argument → Word64)
    (t : Thread cfg) (initial : State Register) (hentry : KernelEntry cfg layout env args data initial)
    (hfinite : FiniteRowTrace data t.rowIndex) :
    ∃ final, run (kernelProgram cfg layout) t.identity (kernelSteps cfg layout)
        initial env (some FP32.floatLibArithmetic) = some final ∧
      KernelResult cfg layout FP32.floatLibArithmetic data (convertedBuffers env args) t initial final ∧
      FP32.isFinite (final.regs .result) = true ∧
      |FP32.toReal (final.regs .result) - exactRowResult data t.rowIndex| ≤
        traceErrorBudget data t.rowIndex := by
  obtain ⟨final, hexec, hr⟩ := kernel_correct cfg layout hfit FP32.floatLibArithmetic data
    env args t initial hentry
  refine ⟨final, hexec, hr, ?_⟩
  rw [hr.result]
  exact rowResult_abs_error_le data _ hfinite

private def smallLayout : Layout := ⟨2, by decide, by decide⟩

private def tieData : TensorData smallLayout 1 :=
  { weights := fun _ _ => 0x3f800000
    input := fun j => if j.val = 0 then 0x3f800000 else 0x33800000
    bias := fun _ => 0x33800000 }

-- FiniteRowTrace checks the complete trace, rather than only the inputs.
private theorem tieFinite : FiniteRowTrace tieData 0 := by
  constructor <;> decide

example : |FP32.toReal (rowResult FP32.floatLibArithmetic tieData 0) -
    exactRowResult tieData 0| ≤ traceErrorBudget tieData 0 :=
  (rowResult_abs_error_le tieData 0 tieFinite).2

-- The theorem stays generic in width, row count, and finite data.
example (data : TensorData layout rows) (i : Fin rows) (hf : FiniteRowTrace data i)
    (k : Nat) (hk : k ≤ layout.inputWidth) :
    |FP32.toReal (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic data i k) -
        exactPrefix data i k| ≤ prefixErrorBudget data i k :=
  prefixAccumulator_abs_error_le data i hf k hk

-- All inputs are finite here, but the first accumulator overflows.
private def overflowData : TensorData smallLayout 1 :=
  { weights := fun _ _ => 0x7f7fffff
    input := fun _ => 0x40000000
    bias := fun _ => 0 }

example : (∀ j, FP32.isFinite (overflowData.weights 0 j) = true) ∧
    (∀ j, FP32.isFinite (overflowData.input j) = true) ∧
    FP32.isFinite (overflowData.bias 0) = true := by decide
example : ¬ FiniteRowTrace overflowData 0 := by
  intro hf
  have h := hf.accumulators ⟨1, by decide⟩
  have hn : FP32.isFinite (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic overflowData 0 1) = false := by
    decide
  rw [hn] at h
  contradiction

#print axioms prefixAccumulator_abs_error_le
#print axioms preactivation_abs_error_le
#print axioms rowResult_abs_error_le
#print axioms kernel_abs_error_le

private def asRat (word : FP32.Bits) : IO Rat :=
  match Model.toRat? (FP32.decode word) with
  | some value => pure value
  | none => throw (IO.userError "Exceptional word in finite rational oracle.")

def main : IO Unit := do
  -- Independent exact-real formulas and hand-computed half-ULP sums.
  -- Cases: accumulated ties, cancellation at the ReLU boundary, gradual underflow.
  let fixtures : List (List FP32.Bits × FP32.Bits × Rat × Rat) :=
    [([0x3f800000, 0x33800000], 0x33800000, 1 + 1 / (2 ^ 23), 3 / (2 ^ 24)),
     ([0x3f800000, 0x33800000], 0xbf800000, 1 / (2 ^ 24),
       2 / (2 ^ 24) + 1 / (2 ^ 150))]
  for (inputs, bias, exactOutput, budget) in fixtures do
    let data : TensorData smallLayout 1 :=
      { weights := fun _ _ => 0x3f800000
        input := fun j => inputs[j.val]!
        bias := fun _ => bias }
    let mut exactDot : Rat := 0
    for x in inputs do exactDot := exactDot + (← asRat x)
    let target := max (exactDot + (← asRat bias)) 0
    let actual ← asRat (rowResult FP32.floatLibArithmetic data 0)
    unless target == exactOutput && actual == (if bias == 0xbf800000 then 0 else 1) &&
        actual != target && abs (actual - target) ≤ budget do
      throw (IO.userError "Accumulated rounding/cancellation oracle failed.")
  let tinyData : TensorData smallLayout 1 :=
    { weights := fun _ j => if j.val = 0 then 1 else 0
      input := fun _ => 0x3f000000
      bias := fun _ => 0 }
  let tiny ← asRat (rowResult FP32.floatLibArithmetic tinyData 0)
  unless tiny == 0 && abs (tiny - 1 / (2 ^ 150)) ≤ 3 / (2 ^ 150) do
    throw (IO.userError "Gradual-underflow error oracle failed.")
  unless !FP32.isFinite (prefixAccumulator FP32.floatLibArithmetic overflowData 0 1) do
    throw (IO.userError "Finite-input overflow was admitted.")
  IO.println "Generic prefix/row error statements, finite trace and overflow exclusion, theorem audits, accumulated ties, ReLU cancellation and subnormal rounding oracles pass."
